task-build-pre.md:
# Build

Before effects read `operation.md` and the relevant `context.operation`; do not load post guidance yet.

Read project instructions, scripts and deployment metadata. Build the declared root-service candidate containing the retained delivery; library-only output is insufficient for a root-service target. Do not switch services, merge, commit or push.

Publish the real candidate, immutable manifest, checks and version into the declared persistent artifact store outside worktrees scheduled for cleanup. Before installation, inventory pre-existing and operation-created caches/links across all configured workspace packages. Missing format, capability or prerequisite is a concrete blocked result, never guessed success.

Before reporting completion, read `task-build-post.md`.
task-build-post.md:
# Verify build

Read `operation-result.md` and `session-protocol.md` before publishing.

Verify the actual candidate, artifact evidence, version and limitations. Release owned caches/links under `operation.md` rules, preserving the published release. Publish its immutable receipt and result; do not mark manual acceptance complete.
task-deploy-pre.md:
# Replace the approved version

Before effects read `operation.md` and the relevant `context.operation`; do not load post guidance yet.

If the declaration selects the host service controller, the host performs the switch; do not duplicate it. Otherwise use the existing authorized persistent project controller for the frozen candidate. Stop the declared old instance before starting the new one on the same address/data; retain rollback and verify health/version. Missing capability is blocked; do not bypass permissions, guess/kill PIDs or start another service.

Before reporting completion, read `task-deploy-post.md`.
task-deploy-post.md:
# Verify replacement

Read `operation-result.md` and `session-protocol.md` before publishing.

Check actual health and the exact approved running version; preserve evidence. On failure follow the authorized rollback procedure and report it. Chat, script exit or a switch receipt alone is insufficient.
task-integrate-pre.md:
# Confirmed Git integration

Before effects read `operation.md` and the relevant `context.operation`; do not load post guidance yet.

- This is submission's Git phase after acceptance and read-only analysis. Read the frozen approval, source/target and choices from context; original delivery restrictions remain.
- Integrate only approved changes into the declared target using project procedures. Preserve source worktree, commit policy, task trailers and unrelated user changes. No altered choices, resets/discards, force-pushes, worktree deletion or unrelated branches.
- If source is already an ancestor of the actual target, report verified targetHead/no-op evidence; do not invent an empty commit.
- Dirty target state alone is not a blocker. Inspect index, working tree, collisions and affected submodules; preserve independent changes exactly. Recheck immediately before mutation. Real overlap, uncertain interactions, changed approved commits or Git safety refusal require a blocked result and fresh user decision.

Before reporting completion, read `task-integrate-post.md`.
task-integrate-post.md:
# Verify integration

Read `operation-result.md` and `session-protocol.md` before publishing.

Run relevant validation and inspect actual target HEAD/Git state. Report exact operation ID, frozen versions, targetHead and evidence. Release owned caches/links under `operation.md` rules. Do not change acceptance or delete branches/worktrees; host cleanup follows verified submission.
operation.md:
# Admitted maintenance

Read `context.operation` and `policy` before effects. Read `session-protocol.md` only for requests/reports/recovery; read `operation-result.md` when producing a result. Use frozen operationId, source/target, approval, resources, deployment and receiptPath; native paths may differ from /workspace aliases.

- Perform only the admitted step: build → replace → accept → submit. Submit is analysis, explicit Git confirmation, integration and host cleanup, retaining Session history. Acceptance/analysis alone does not complete the task. Skips are linked waivers; cancellation needs formal stop receipts. Never replay unknown effects or repeat integration for cleanup retry.
- Discover project commands. Resolve writable paths/symlinks, isolate caches/temp/output in the worktree, retain HOME/config and reuse shared objects read-only. Extra destinations require frozen authorization. Use command-scoped frozen Git identity; preserve unknown ownership and user files.
- Build/deploy scripts and manifests must be operation-scoped and idempotent, recording inputs, candidate, approval, rollback and cache/link ownership before effects. Build may run bounded foreground. Deployment uses the declared persistent controller; do not duplicate a host-controlled switch or depend on browser/old-httpd lifetime, detached shell, guessed PIDs or embedded MCP secrets. Missing capability is blocked.
- During phase cleanup, inspect ignored/untracked paths in all workspace packages and initialized repositories. Remove only proven operation/predecessor-created reproducible caches/links. Preserve source, pre-existing files, published artifacts and unknown ownership; never follow links into another checkout. Unconfirmed cleanup cannot pass.
operation-result.md:
# Maintenance result

Read `session-protocol.md` before publishing.

Atomically publish build/deploy receipts to context.operation.receiptPath, then report the SAME immutable payload:
`{schema:"nestos.kanban.operation-result/1",operationId,sourceVersion,targetVersion,status:"succeeded"|"blocked"|"failed",version,evidence:{path,sha256},summary}`.

Evidence is the actual project-relative manifest, preferably under artifacts, not a receipt/prompt. Integration uses this schema plus verified targetHead and approved choices. Scripts/chat/receipts alone are not proof. Host validates results after the turn; only host cleanup deletes worktrees.

Read `session-learnings.md` before the final result.
